patch_description: This rewrite keeps the same inputs/outputs as the original program but modifies the ANSATZ_SPEC to share the center rotation parameter across pre- and post-entanglement layers. Specifically, the center RZ on wire 8 now uses a single parameter key (rz_center) for both pre- and post-center rotations. This reduces the per-block parameter count to 10 (matching the observed optimization target) while preserving the symmetry-inspired structure and the overall data-encoding/training workflow. The hub- and ring-entanglement blocks remain unchanged, maintaining the fixed re-uploading scheme and measurement protocol. The change is isolated to the EVOLVE-BLOCK region, ensuring compatibility with the fixed training loop, data construction, and evaluation metrics.
